proposal_delivery_comparison.text: For your stroller, the Nexon provides 382 litres of boot space on petrol and diesel models under ISO V215 measurement, offering dedicated cargo space for your family outings.
For your child seat, ISOFIX child seat mounts come standard across all variants, providing built-in mounting points in the rear cabin.
For your daily five to ten kilometres in city traffic, six airbags and an electronic stability program come standard across every variant.
Let's begin with the cargo space to see how it fits your stroller.
Next, let's look at the standard safety features relevant to your child seat.
Now let's check the cabin display and controls for your daily city driving.
Finally, let's look at warranty coverage and quote details for running costs.

facts.value: 6 Airbags, 3 point ELR for all occupants and Electronic stability program as standard

source.quote: New Nexon takes the safety to new level with 6 Airbags, 3 point ELR for all occupants and Electronic stability program as standard

facts.conditions: Manufacturer states six airbags and electronic stability program as standard; three-point ELR belts are stated for all occupants. Do not infer child-seat compatibility or a crash-outcome guarantee.
Standard across variants; footnoted '* As standard'; attachment-point count and universal compatibility not stated.

source.locator: PDF page 40: Bharat NCAP five-star rating graphic and applicability footnote
source.quote: Nexon BNCAP safety rating is applicable for Petrol & Diesel trims active as on May'26.

facts.conditions: Manufacturer-reported Bharat NCAP five-star rating; petrol and diesel trims active as of May 2026. Do not extend this scope to CNG or infer a rival ranking.

source.locator: PDF page 38: Pure + feature panel; pages 38–39: additional-equipment persona hierarchy

facts.conditions: Pure + and higher in the documented petrol/diesel persona hierarchy. Smart + lists a smaller screen. The brochure directs iCNG features to a separate iCNG list.

source.locator: PDF page 39: Fearless + PS feature panel

facts.conditions: Fearless + PS in the documented petrol/diesel persona list; not a whole-range display specification. Consult the separate iCNG feature list for iCNG.

facts.value: 382 L for Petrol & Diesel; 321 L for CNG

source.locator: PDF page 40: Boot Space row, Petrol/Diesel versus Petrol + CNG columns; ** measurement footnote

facts.conditions: 382 L in the petrol/diesel columns and 321 L in the Petrol + CNG column. Brochure measurement basis: ISO V215. Litres do not establish that a particular stroller or luggage set fits.

source.locator: PDF page 40 powertrain matrix: Fearless + PS row, Petrol 1.2 Turbocharged Engine / DCA column is ticked; PDF page 18 automatic label

facts.conditions: The May 2026 brochure matrix lists DCA for Fearless + PS petrol; page 18 supplies the seven-speed automatic label. This is a supported powertrain pairing, not proof of current dealer stock or delivery date.
Available on Fearless + PS petrol/diesel persona; does not apply to rear seats or lower trims.

facts.value: Front Collision Warning, Autonomous Emergency Braking, Lane Centering System, Traffic Sign Recognition, Lane Departure Warning, High Beam Assist, Lane Keep Assist

source.quote: Front Collision Warning Autonomous Emergency Braking Lane Centering System Traffic Sign Recognition Lane Departure Warning High Beam Assist Lane Keep Assist

facts.conditions: Only Fearless + PS petrol DCA; ADAS is not available in CNG or diesel, per the page-40 footnote.

source.locator: PDF page 17: audio feature label; page 40: JBL/subwoofer availability footnotes

facts.conditions: JBL branded speaker system and subwoofer only on Fearless + PS DCA; subwoofer is unavailable in CNG. The wording does not establish a tenth speaker.
Advertised basic warranty headline; specific terms, exclusions, transferability, or 'whichever occurs first' qualification not detailed in source badge.

User requested mute at boot check-in; subsequent delivery evidence is captions/transcript only.
